## Checklist:

- [ ] `make qa` passes, or any checks that could not be run are listed with reasons.
- [ ] Any new code line is covered by unit tests and the coverage has not dropped.
- [ ] Any new code follows the style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] The code changes have been self-reviewed.
- [ ] Corresponding changes to the documentation have been made.
- [ ] VERSION is unchanged; maintainers manage version bumps at release time.

## Type of change:

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue).
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality).
- [ ] Breaking change (describe compatibility and migration impact).
- [ ] Automation.
- [ ] Documentation.
- [ ] Example.
- [ ] Testing.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Packaging checks are optional unless the
change affects packaging; note any packaging tools that were unavailable.
